description: Mark a feedback item as resolved in layernote. Only call this once the point has actually been dealt with: in the code, the design or the file. If it will NOT be done (a false positive, intentional, out of scope), use wont_fix_feedback instead so the team sees the reason rather than a false "fixed".

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: resolve_feedback
title: Resolve a feedback item
